texts.preamble: Harsh Kumar Agrwal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2020 Author: Manju Rani Chauhan Bench: Manju Rani Chauhan High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 76 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5452 of 2020 Applicant :- Harsh Kumar Agrwal
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present criminal proceedings initiated by opposite party no.2 are an after thought, as such the same are not only malicious but also amount to an abuse of the process of the Court. Harsh Kumar Agrwal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129357775/ 1 Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that from perusal of the records, prima facie, it can not be said at this stage that no offence has been committed by the applicants. The cases of (1) Chandra Deo Singh Vs. Prokash Chandra Bose AIR 1963 SC 1430 , (2) Vadilal Panchal Vs. Dattatraya Dulaji Ghadigaonker AIR 1960 SC 1113 and (3) Smt. Nagawwa Vs. Veeranna Shivalingappa Konjalgi 1976 3 SCC 736 may be usefully referred to in this regard. The Apex Court decisions given in the case of R.P. Kapur Vs. State of Punjab AIR 1960 SC 866 and in the case of State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal 1992 SCC(Cr.) 426 have also recognized certain categories by way of illustration which may justify the quashing of a complaint or charge sheet. Some of them are akin to the illustrative examples given in the above referred case of Smt. Nagawwa Vs. Veeranna Shivalingappa Konjalgi 1976 3 SCC 736. Hon'ble Apex Court in Bhajan Lal's case has recognized certain categories in which Section-482 of Cr.P.C. or Article-226 of the Constitution may be successfully invoked. This Court does not deem it proper, and therefore cannot be persuaded to have a Harsh Kumar Agrwal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129357775/ 2 pre-trial before the actual trial begins.
